sub_sector.value: MRO industrial distribution; pumps and rotating equipment; supply chain services

logistics_role.detail: Distributes MRO products: rotating equipment, bearings, power transmission, metalworking, safety and industrial supplies to industrial customers.

asset_intensity.detail: Operates service centers and a national distribution network; no fleet-based model, so moderately asset-based.

value_added.detail: Supply chain and inventory management, pump fabrication, repair and rebuild, field service, and technical support.
